name: AI Autonomous Account Research Agent (dhRobin Systems)

parameters.content:
## n8n-ai-autonomous-account-research-agent
**dhRobin Systems** · HubSpot company created → web intelligence (Exa / Perplexity) → LLM brief → HubSpot note + Slack.

**Safe by default.** With no environment variables set:
- `SANDBOX_MODE=true`: mock company lookup, mock research, mock synthesis. **Zero external calls.**
- `DRY_RUN=true`: the note is rendered but never written.
- `WRITE_TO_HUBSPOT=false`, `NOTIFY_SLACK=false`: both writes need an explicit opt-in.

Secrets appear only as `$env.*` in HTTP header/URL fields. The one exception is the HMAC check in *Verify & Parse*, which reads `HUBSPOT_APP_CLIENT_SECRET` in memory and never outputs it.

### Pinned synthetic payloads
Pinned on: Webhook, HubSpot: Get Company, Exa: Search, Perplexity: Search, OpenAI: Synthesize Brief, HubSpot: Create Company Note, Slack: Post Alert.

Pins apply to **manual executions only**. Production webhook executions ignore them. Unpin a node before a manual live test of that integration. Pinned item counts match the pinned webhook event (2 companies, 1 qualified, 3 research topics).

nodes.name: HubSpot: Company Created Webhook
nodes.notes: Subscribe a HubSpot private/public app to company.creation and point it at this production URL. Responds 200 immediately.

nodes.name: Build Synthetic Webhook Event
nodes.notes: Emits a webhook-shaped request with fictitious events.

nodes.name: Config & Safety Gate
nodes.notes: Typed, non-secret runtime config under `config.*`. Incoming request fields pass through unchanged.

nodes.name: Verify & Parse HubSpot Events
nodes.notes: v3 signature check, event parsing, de-duplication, batch cap.

nodes.name: No Events: End
nodes.notes: Inspect skipReason and counters.

nodes.name: Mock HubSpot Company Lookup
nodes.notes: Fictitious company records.

nodes.name: HubSpot: Get Company
nodes.notes: Scope: crm.objects.companies.read. Fetches only firmographic properties.

nodes.name: Normalize Domain & Qualify
nodes.notes: Domain normalisation, consumer/disposable filtering, ICP criteria.

nodes.name: Skipped: Not Qualified
nodes.notes: See disqualifyReason on each item.

nodes.name: Build Research Queries
nodes.notes: One item per (company, topic) with Exa and Perplexity bodies.

nodes.name: Mock Research Generator
nodes.notes: Offline research in the live output shape.

nodes.name: Exa: Search
nodes.notes: Neural/auto search with text contents. Errors continue so one failed topic does not sink the brief.

parameters.jsCode:
// Skip Exa: RESEARCH_MODE excludes Exa for this run.
return $input.all().map((item) => ({ json: { ...item.json, exa: [], exaError: null } }));

nodes.name: Perplexity: Search
nodes.notes: Sonar search with recency filter. Citations are re-keyed to S-IDs downstream.

parameters.jsCode:
// Skip Perplexity: RESEARCH_MODE excludes Perplexity for this run.
return $input.all().map((item) => ({ json: { ...item.json, perplexity: null, perplexityError: null } }));

nodes.name: Aggregate Research per Company
nodes.notes: Source de-duplication and citation IDs.

nodes.name: Build Synthesis Request
nodes.notes: Strict JSON Schema brief request.

nodes.name: OpenAI: Synthesize Brief
nodes.notes: OpenAI-compatible endpoint with structured outputs (json_schema).

nodes.name: Mock Synthesis
nodes.notes: Deterministic, schema-valid brief.

nodes.name: Validate Brief & Render Note
nodes.notes: Citation contract, scrubbing, HTML note, Slack payload.

nodes.name: Dry Run: Brief Preview
nodes.notes: Review noteHtml, brief and slackPayload. Nothing is written while DRY_RUN is not 'false'.

nodes.name: HubSpot: Create Company Note
nodes.notes: Creates a note associated to the company (associationTypeId 190). Needs the write scope HubSpot lists for the Notes API on your app (see README §7.17).

nodes.name: Slack: Post Alert
nodes.notes: Slack incoming webhook; the URL itself is a secret.

results.text: The new Chief Revenue Officer joins from a national 3PL to lead enterprise shipper growth.

results.text: Promotion supports the network expansion programme.
